title: Governed project document frontmatter envelope

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier; never changed, never reused.

status.$comment: Lifecycle: active = in force or current (binding current-state; task-record being applied; non-authoritative document that is the current account of its subject); inactive = historical evidence, no authority, kept only while referenced (non-authoritative: superseded). Supersession of current-state is an in-place edit (git holds prior versions); a record's body is edited in place only in the two cases §5 names; a document nothing should reference is deleted.

$comment: additionalProperties stays true by design: upper layers and modules extend the envelope. No field duplicates git metadata; the repository owns history.
